Appendix J — Deployment Checklist (Staging and Production)

Pre-deployment (T-3 to T-1 days)

  • Change record approved; window agreed with client; stakeholders informed.
  • Release candidate tagged; artifact/image digest recorded; SBOM and scans attached.
  • Environment configuration reviewed (no secrets in repo; values in secret store); configuration diff vs staging checked.
  • Database migrations rehearsed on a copy of production; duration measured.
  • Verified backup taken and restore tested; backup location and time recorded.
  • Rollback plan written with decision point and time limit; data-rollback approach defined.
  • Monitoring dashboards and alerts ready; on-call contacts confirmed.
  • Runbook reviewed by a second engineer.

Deployment

  • Freeze: no other changes to the environment.
  • Maintenance notice shown if downtime is expected.
  • Deploy via pipeline (no manual file copy).
  • Run migrations; confirm version number.
  • Smoke tests: login, one transaction per module, reports, integrations, scheduled jobs.
  • Check logs/metrics for errors; compare latency/error rate to baseline.

Post-deployment

  • Client SPOC confirms smoke test on production.
  • Hyper-care schedule active (24–72 h); issue channel open.
  • Release notes sent; documentation updated.
  • Change record closed with result and timings.
  • Backups scheduled and first scheduled backup verified.
  • Retrospective logged if any deviation.

Rollback triggers (example)

  • Smoke test failure in a Must function; error rate > 2× baseline for 10 minutes; data-integrity discrepancy; security issue discovered.

Appendix L — Project Costing Model Specification

Specification for the department's estimating workbook (spreadsheet or small web tool). Implementation must reproduce the worked examples in Chapter 8 to the rupee — those are the acceptance tests.

Sheets

SheetPurposeKey columns / cells
InputsGlobal assumptions (versioned, dated).Cost/day by role · target margin · PM ratio · phase ratios · contingency by size · overhead/month · management fee % · support/upgrade % · tax note
RateCardBilling rates derived from cost.Role · cost/day · rate/day = cost ÷ (1 − margin)
ModulesThree-point estimates.Module · FR range · O · M · P · expected = (O+4M+P)/6 · risk flag
PhasesEffort by lifecycle component.Component · basis · days · cost/day · cost
IntegrationsPer interface.Name · complexity (3/6/12 d) · vendor · sandbox availability
MigrationPer data source.Source · tables · quality · days
Hosting&LicencesQuoted from official calculators/vendor quotes.Service · SKU · region · unit price · qty · months · source URL · date verified · screenshot ref
SummaryPrice, margin, schedule.Labour · contingency · licences · hosting · direct · price · margin % · payment schedule
RecurringAnnual support, hosting, upgrades.Support % · hosting × 12 × (1+fee) · upgrade block
BreakEvenDepartment economics.Overhead/month · contribution per project · projects/year
ChangeRequestsCR log and pricing.CR ID · roles/days · assessment fee · post-freeze premium · status

Formulas (authoritative)

text
LabourCost      = Σ ( Days[c] × CostPerDay[c] )                    over all components c incl. Project Management
PM_Days         = PM_Ratio × Σ Days[c ≠ PM]
Contingency     = LabourCost × Risk%                              (10 % small, 15 % medium, 20 % enterprise)
DirectCost      = LabourCost + Contingency + Licences + BuildHosting
Price           = DirectCost ÷ (1 − TargetMargin)                   (TargetMargin default 0.40; floor 0.30)
GrossMargin%    = (Price − DirectCost) ÷ Price
ModulePrice[m]  = (Price − SharedPrice − LicHostPrice) × DevDays[m] ÷ Σ DevDays
SharedPrice     = (IntegrationCost + MigrationCost) × (1 + Risk%) ÷ (1 − TargetMargin)
AnnualSupport   = Support% × Price ;  AnnualHosting = Monthly × 12 × (1 + MgmtFee)
BreakEven       = 12 × OverheadPerMonth ÷ (Price − DirectCost)       projects per year
ChangeRequest   = 0.5×BA_rate + Σ(days × rate) × (1 + 0.20 if after freeze)

Controls

  • Inputs sheet is versioned and dated; changing a rate requires Department Head approval.
  • Every price in Hosting&Licences carries source URL, SKU, region, date verified — no row without evidence.
  • Technical Lead reviews module days; Finance reviews margin; both initial the Summary sheet.
  • Model must fail validation if: margin < floor, contingency missing, any of the 17 cost components has zero days without a written reason.
  • Export a PDF quote snapshot stored with the SOW; never overwrite a quoted version.
